Answer all the questions.

2A)               Suggest the parameters considered while selecting Front or rear projected display devices.           (2)

3A)   A metal plate is to be punched with a hole, the plate can take a maximum shear stress of 150 MPa. (5)  
  The compressive stress in the punch is limited to 200 MPa.  
  Determine:  
  i) Maximum thickness of the plate for which a 50 mm diameter hole can be punched  
  ii) If the plate is 5 mm thick, smallest diameter hole that can be punched.  
  
  
3B)   When a tensile axial load was applied on a round bar of 40mm diameter and 2.5m length, the          (5)  
  extension observed was 2.5 mm. Calculate the bulk modulus and lateral contraction of the bar if E =  
  $$170 GPa & G = 63 GPa.$$  
4A)                                                                                                         (5)  
  
  
4B)   A circular rod of 25mm diameter and 500mm long is subjected to a tensile force of 60kN. Determine (5)  
  the modulus of rigidity, bulk modulus and change in volume if Poisson's ratio is 0.3 and Young's  
  $$modulus E = 2\times 105 N/mm2 .$$  
  
5A)   Describe the technical specifications of strain gauges.                                             (6)  
5B)   Discuss the merits and demerits of load cells and temperature sensors.                              (4)
